en: Illustrated heraldic postcard featuring the coat of arms associated with Nijmegen. At the center is a crowned shield with a black double-headed eagle on gold and a smaller blue shield with a lion on its chest, flanked by a yellow lion on the left and a black lion on the right. Above the shield is a yellow-and-black striped flag on a pole. At the upper corners are two medieval-style seals with inscriptions and figures. At the bottom, the name 'NIJMEGEN' is printed in large capital letters.
